Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** a false spec-validation error tells an author their field carries a retired key it does not carry.
- **Lane:** `domain:ui`. The landing is `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`. Do not patch `formula: undefined` onto the draft. ⛔ Do not silence the client check instead.

Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over the named paths: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no (no export, prop or type changes; the draft stops carrying an own `formula` key)
Responsibility: `@object-ui/app-shell`'s object field inspector patches `formula: undefined` onto the draft, so the client spec check's strict parse reports an own `formula` key as `unrecognized_keys` on a field that carries none | the wire drops `undefined`, so nothing bad is saved and the banner clears after the autosave; nothing covers the false banner itself | every author who edits a formula field's expression on a clean field, measured 2/2 on fresh loads (the card's reproduction)
Thread-read: 6218314690
Serial constraints cleared: objectui#12680 (this seat, PR #12745) changes `ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx`, `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx`, `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, all disjoint from this surface. It was answered not-fold in its claim (`6219751291`): a different defect shape. No other in-flight `domain:ui` claim and no open objectui PR names `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` or `clientValidation.ts`, read across the lane's `pm:dispatched` claims and every open PR's file list 2026-10-16T17:33Z. The line the card quotes stands on `main` (`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx:1124`, `formula: undefined`).
